title: Integrating bioinformatics and ferroptosis to reveal the protective mechanism of Astragaloside IV on chronic heart failure rats.
authors: Yuan, Hui; Shi, Min; Wei, Jiaming; Liu, Chengxin; Wang, Ziyan; Li, Ya; Guo, Zhihua
one_liner_zh: 该文整合生物信息学与铁死亡研究黄芪甲苷对心衰大鼠的保护机制，涉及p53与AS-IV的分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ferroptosis is an important pathological mechanism of chronic heart failure (CHF). This study aimed to investigate the protective mechanism of Astragaloside IV (AS-IV) on CHF rats by integrating bioinformatics and ferroptosis. CHF-related targets and ferroptosis-related targets were collected. After the intersection, the common targets were obtained. The PPI network of the common targets was constructed, and topological analysis of the network was carried out. The target with the highest topological parameter values was selected as the key target. The key target p53 was obtained through bioinformatics analysis, and its molecular docking model with AS-IV was obtained, as well as molecular dynamics simulation analysis. The rat models of CHF after myocardial infarction were established by ligation of left coronary artery and treated with AS-IV for 4 weeks. AS-IV treatment significantly improved cardiac function in CHF rats, improved cardiomyocyte morphology and myocardial fibrosis, reduced mitochondrial damage, decreased myocardial MDA and Fe(2+) content, increased GSH content, inhibited the expression of p53 and p-p53, and up-regulated the expression of SLC7A11 and GPX4. In conclusion, AS-IV improved cardiac function in CHF rats, presumably by regulating p53/SLC7A11/GPX4 signaling pathway and inhibiting myocardial ferroptosis.
abstract_zh: 铁死亡（ferroptosis）是慢性心力衰竭（CHF）的重要病理机制。本研究旨在通过整合生物信息学与铁死亡，探讨黄芪甲苷IV（AS-IV）对CHF大鼠的保护机制。收集CHF相关靶点与铁死亡相关靶点，取交集后获得共同靶点。构建共同靶点的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，并进行网络拓扑分析。选取拓扑参数值最高的靶点作为关键靶点。通过生物信息学分析获得关键靶点p53，并得到其与AS-IV的分子对接模型及分子动力学模拟分析。通过结扎左冠状动脉建立心肌梗死后CHF大鼠模型，并用AS-IV治疗4周。AS-IV治疗显著改善了CHF大鼠的心功能，改善了心肌细胞形态和心肌纤维化，减少了线粒体损伤，降低了心肌MDA和Fe(2+)含量，增加了GSH含量，抑制了p53和p-p53的表达，并上调了SLC7A11和GPX4的表达。总之，AS-IV改善了CHF大鼠的心功能，推测其通过调节p53/SLC7A11/GPX4信号通路并抑制心肌铁死亡来实现。
